text:
danielle: Quick question 1 1 Fancy a low-key mocktail-making happy hour + optional 15m karaoke corner this Thu at 7pm? There's a lounge near the office with a private corner. Could keep it casual: 45m mixing, 30m hang/karaoke. Who's interested? :tropical_drink: :microphone:

omar: Ooh yes. Can we have at least one non-alcoholic mocktail please (allergies).

rachael: I'm in. Also volunteer to bring a portable mic if needed.

zane: love it. voting for Thu. random thought: 2-song rule for karaoke so no one gets stuck on stage. :grin:

events-bot: FYI: Cap for private corner is 20 people. Bookings require RSVP + dietary notes. Reply here or use the RSVP poll the organizer posts.

ops-bot: Reminder: team socials under $15/attendee can be submitted via "team-social" expense category at https://redwood.internal/expenses. Attach receipts and attendee list.

danielle: i'll do a 1-question poll: :tropical_drink: = coming, :house: = remote but might drop in chat/zoom, :x: = can't make it. Also posting a quick dietary/allergy form in the invite.

bryce-remote: :house: I'll be remote but happy to drop in via Zoom for the karaoke (bad singing guaranteed).

omar: :tropical_drink:

rachael: :tropical_drink:

zane: :tropical_drink:

danielle: Great looks like enough people. I'll try to secure the corner and ask venue to hold space for 7-8pm. If booking fee applies, I'll check with People Ops about a $10/head voucher.

events-bot: If you want the mic + small PA checked, submit a quick equipment request at https://redwood.internal/events. We can often cover speaker rental up to $40.

rachael: Also tagging @design 1 for a tiny printable sign for the karaoke corner? One-liner "Redwood Mocktail Lab + Karaoke" would be cute.

zane: I'm bringing a small song list cheat sheet so people can pick songs quickly. Two-song limit enforced by yours truly. :sunglasses:

bryce-remote: if you stream karaoke i'll shout out song suggestions in the chat. happy to DJ remotely.

omar: If People Ops okays vouchers, can we reserve 3 for the top singers? small fun prize.

danielle: will confirm with Ops. If not, we'll do bragging rights + a paper ribbon. Low-key wins. I'll post the calendar invite with RSVP + zoom link. See y'all Thu 7pm!
